threat_event: A buyer wires deposit or cash to close to a fraudster after spoofed instructions from a compromised agent mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-only agent mailboxes; agents email buyers outside the portal; buyers trust the agent address
existing_controls: Portal-only title instructions; wire fraud warnings in contracts and email footers; impersonation protection
treatment_plan: Agent MFA; block instruction-like content from agent mail to buyers; buyer warnings at every milestone
owner: Residential Brokerage security and compliance lead

threat_event: Earnest money deposit instructions forwarded by email are altered in transit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Brokerage escrow instructions are in the portal since 2024, but agents still forward them by email in some transactions
treatment_plan: Disable agent forwarding of instructions; buyers receive deposit instructions only in SYS-B2

threat_event: Password-only contractor agent accounts are taken over by phishing or credential stuffing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,900 agents without MFA; exception expired 2026-06-30; legacy protocols allowed for them
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA by 2026-12-31 and disable non-compliant accounts; block legacy protocols

threat_event: Departed agents keep access to client files and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Managing brokers report departures late (median 4 days, up to 31)
treatment_plan: Automated disablement from the license transfer feed and the agent exit form; weekly reconciliation
owner: Residential Brokerage director of agent services

threat_event: Client data on agents personal devices is lost or copied to unmanaged apps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 90,000 personal devices; no app protection policy for mobile email; SYS-B1 downloads allowed
existing_controls: Browser access only for SYS-B1 on unmanaged laptops
treatment_plan: App protection policy on mobile email; block downloads from unmanaged devices

threat_event: A brokerage escrow refund wire is sent to a fraudster after a spoofed refund request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refund wires do not use out-of-band payee verification
regulatory_driver: N53-R01 (314.3(b)) by group policy; Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(d)1. (worked example)
treatment_plan: Route every refund through SYS-G5 payee verification with callback to the number in the contract file

threat_event: A property owner payout bank change request is spoofed and distributions are diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner bank changes accepted in SYS-B4 without callback
treatment_plan: Callback verification and a 5-day hold on new owner accounts
owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management

threat_event: An agent commission account change is spoofed and commissions are diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commission account changes accepted from agent email
treatment_plan: Self-service changes only through SYS-G1-authenticated portal with notice to the old address

threat_event: Payee or document changes and bulk exports in SYS-B1 go unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-B1 audit logs not collected
treatment_plan: Collect SYS-B1 audit logs; alerts on instruction-like documents uploaded by agents and on bulk downloads

threat_event: Agents view other agents clients and Title settlement statements without need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office-level visibility in SYS-B1
treatment_plan: Transaction-team visibility; Title documents visible only to the listing and selling agents

threat_event: Stolen integration service API keys give bulk access to SYS-B1 and SYS-M2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two static keys last rotated 2025-03
existing_controls: Keys in the secret store; no human access
treatment_plan: Rotate now; move to workload identity and short-lived tokens

threat_event: TMCC and CRM data are reused for affiliate marketing and analytics without documented purpose or consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly TMCC feed to the Group Data Platform; lead API to SYS-M1
existing_controls: Affiliated business disclosure recorded at referral
treatment_plan: Stop the nightly feed until purposes are approved; consent capture for lead sharing

threat_event: A portal outage pushes staff to email wire instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Habit of email under pressure
treatment_plan: Quarterly failover tests; outage script for coordinators

threat_event: A breach at the transaction platform vendor exposes client files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds files on about 3.1 million consumers
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed each year
treatment_plan: Contract notice within 72 hours; reduce data held through retention (BR-018)

threat_event: Ransomware on sales office endpoints spreads and disrupts transaction work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many small offices with shared printers and local file shares
existing_controls: EDR; no local servers holding client files
treatment_plan: Remove local file shares; office network segmentation
owner: Residential Brokerage security and compliance lead

threat_event: Tenant screening recommendations deny or condition applicants unlawfully or on wrong records (AI-001)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disparity testing; recommendation used as the decision; name-only record matching
regulatory_driver: Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604; FCRA 15 U.S.C. 1681m(a); N53-R02 (45(a))
existing_controls: Leasing staff can override; reason codes shown
treatment_plan: Disparity testing, individualized review, configuration changes, and vendor documentation (P10)
owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management

threat_event: Applicants who receive conditional approvals get no FCRA adverse action notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notices are generated only for declines
treatment_plan: Notice for every decline and conditional approval
owner: Residential Brokerage president of property management

threat_event: Transaction files and consumer reports kept indefinitely widen any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-B1 retention set to indefinite; consumer reports kept in SYS-B4
treatment_plan: Retention schedule: purge closed files after the state record-keeping period; dispose of consumer reports after the leasing decision period

threat_event: Buyer lead scoring gives slower service to buyers in protected groups (AI-002)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ZIP code and inquiry language used as inputs
treatment_plan: Remove proxy inputs; response-time parity monitoring

threat_event: A diverted deposit leads to an escrow dispute and a missed notice to the real estate commission
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Escrow dispute steps are not linked to the incident runbook
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 475.25(1)(d)1.; Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-10.032 (worked example)
treatment_plan: Add the escrow dispute notice to the notification matrix

threat_event: Generative AI drafts listing descriptions with discriminatory statements (AI-003)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents publish drafts with light review
existing_controls: Marketing review of brand ads only
treatment_plan: Fair housing language check in the tool; agent training

threat_event: A buyer portal account is taken over through the buyer own email account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal sign-in uses an emailed code
existing_controls: Identity proofing and re-authentication before instructions are shown
treatment_plan: Notify the buyer by SMS on every new device sign-in

threat_event: A deposit is not placed in escrow on time or a diversion is missed in reconciliation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual matching for deposits received by wire
regulatory_driver: Fla. Admin. Code r. 61J2-14.008(3) and r. 61J2-14.012 (worked example)
existing_controls: Monthly reconciliation signed by the Broker of Record
treatment_plan: Daily automated matching of expected and received deposits

threat_event: A caller impersonating a seller or buyer passes escrow callback checks with a synthetic voice
threat_source: Organized fraud groups using generative AI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Voice-only callbacks
treatment_plan: Second-channel confirmation in SYS-B2 for refund changes

threat_event: A company laptop holding transaction documents is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops are encrypted and managed
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes disclosure unlikely
owner: Residential Brokerage security and compliance lead

threat_event: The rent payment hosted page is tampered with to capture card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment page hosted by the processor; the portal links to it
existing_controls: Processor attestation; no card data in group systems
treatment_plan: Accepted: processor responsibility; link integrity checked monthly
owner: Residential Brokerage security and compliance lead
